idea.name: VidyaBuddy
idea.description: An AI tutor app that gives vernacular-language practice questions and doubt solving for CBSE students in Class 8 to 10.
idea.target_market: Class 8-10 students in tier-2 and tier-3 Indian cities

idea.name: CareLoop
idea.description: A remote monitoring platform that helps elderly patients with diabetes and hypertension share daily readings with their doctors.
idea.target_market: Elderly chronic-disease patients and their families in metro cities

idea.name: KisanSense
idea.description: Low-cost soil moisture sensors with a mobile app that sends irrigation and crop advisory alerts to small farmers.
idea.target_market: Small and marginal farmers growing vegetables and pulses in Karnataka

idea.name: ShelfSmart
idea.description: An inventory and demand-forecasting tool for small kirana stores that suggests what to reorder using sales history.
idea.target_market: Independent kirana and small grocery store owners in Indian cities
